kwame.text: Hello? Yes, Adinkra Hotel.
Kwame speaking. How can I help you today?
Good morning, Adinkra Hotel.
This is Kwame. Akwaaba.
Welcome to Adinkra Hotel.
What can I do for you?
Ah, let me check that for you.
Yes, we have the executive suite available
for those dates. That's $200 per night.
Breakfast is included.
Our standard room is $80.
Deluxe is $120. Check-in is at 2 in the afternoon.
Check-out is 11 in the morning.
Would you like ocean view or city view?
How many guests will be staying with us?
Shall I hold the booking for you?
I'll need your full name, phone number, and
email address. Let me repeat that back.
Executive suite, March 15th to 18th, two guests.
Your booking is confirmed.
You'll get a confirmation email shortly.
Is there anything else I can help with?
I'm really sorry about that.
That's not the experience we want for you.
Let me connect you with my manager right away.
We have a swimming pool, restaurant, free Wi-Fi,
and airport shuttle.
Breakfast is served from 6.30 to 10 every morning.
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in.
We accept visa, MasterCard, mobile money, and
cash.
A deposit equal to the first night is required.
The airport is 30 minutes away.
Shuttle is $25.
You're most welcome.
Safe travels, and we'll see you soon.
Thank you for calling Adinkra Hotel.
Enjoy the rest of your day.

amina.text: Hello, this is Amina. How can I help you today?
Good morning, Amina speaking.
What can I do for you?
Karibu. Welcome to Cynea Bank.
How may I assist you? Let me check your account.
Yes, I can see your balance.
Your current balance is 15,000 shillings.
Your last transaction was yesterday.
A payment of 2,000 shillings.
Would you like me to help with that transfer?
I'll need your account number and phone number
to verify. Let me repeat that.
Account number 123456. Is that correct?
Your payment has been processed.
You'll get an SMS confirmation.
Is there anything else I can help with today?
I'm sorry to hear about that.
Let me look into it.
I understand your frustration.
Let me fix this right away.
Your card has been blocked for security.
A new one will arrive in five days.
We can reverse that transaction.
It will take up to 24 hours.
M-Pesa payments usually reflect within a few
minutes.
Sawasawa. No problem at all.
Poll for the inconvenience.
Let me make it right. I'll transfer you to
the disputes team now.
Thank you for calling.
Aseante sana. Have a good day.

kofi.text: Akwaaba. This is Kofi at Asaase Restaurant.
Ready to take your order?
Hello, Asaase Restaurant.
Kofi speaking. What can I get for you?
Good evening. Kofi here.
Are we doing dine-in, takeaway, or delivery?
Haha, great choice. Jollof with chicken, medium
spice. Would you like kelewele with that?
It's fresh today. Our specials today are banku
with tilapia and groundnut soup.
Let me repeat your order.
Jollof rice with chicken, medium spice, extra
kelewele. That comes to 53 cedis.
How would you like to pay?
Okay. We accept mobile money, cash on delivery,
and card payment. Your order number is 47.
It'll be ready in 25 minutes.
Delivery to that area takes about 30 minutes.
Is that okay? Sorry, we're out of Wakie today.
Can I suggest Jollof instead?
Any allergies I should know about?
We use groundnuts and some dishes.
Would you like a drink?
Sobolo is very fresh today.
Your food is on the way.
The writer will call when nearby.
Thank you for choosing Asease Restaurant.
Enjoy your meal.
We have a special on fried rice this week.
Two for 30 cedis. Let me check with the kitchen.
One moment, please.
Sawa, sawa. I've added extra pepper for you.
Thank you for calling.
Medase. Come again soon.

maya.text: Hello, this is Maya from Cynea Scheduling.
How can I help you today?
Good morning, Maya speaking.
What appointment would you like to book?
I can help you schedule a booking.
What date works best for you?
Let me check availability.
One moment, please. Yes, we have
slots available on Tuesday at 10 in the morning.
Would you prefer morning or afternoon?
I can book
you for Thursday at 2 in the afternoon.
Does that work? Let me repeat that.
Tuesday, March 15th,
10 in the morning, correct?
Your appointment is confirmed.
You'll get an SMS reminder.
Would you like to reschedule?
I can help with that. I'm sorry, that time
is fully booked.
How about 1130? The doctor is available on
Friday, morning or afternoon.
Your booking
reference is C-Y-N472.
Note that down. A reminder will be sent one
day before your appointment.
Is there anything else I can help you schedule?
I understand. Let me find an earlier slot for
you.
Sawa sawa. Your booking is all set.
Thank you for choosing Cynea.
Have a wonderful day.
Goodbye, and see you on Tuesday.
